meta.title: The Neon Heist
meta.subtitle: A powerful corporation controls the city. Tonight, you’re breaking in.
meta.historyEmptyText: Your path will be recorded here as you make choices.

scenes.title: Rooftop Entry
scenes.narrative:
Rain falls across neon-lit rooftops as you crouch above the target building.

Below you is Helix Corp, a megacorporation rumored to be hiding something massive. Your contact said the data inside could change everything.

You have three ways in.

scenes.title: Vent System
scenes.narrative:
You slide into the narrow vent system. The metal creaks under your weight.

Voices echo from below. Guards are talking about a lockdown protocol.

scenes.title: Main Entrance
scenes.narrative:
You connect your device to the security panel.

The system fights back with heavy encryption. You can force it open, but it might trigger alarms.

scenes.title: Fire Escape
scenes.narrative:
You climb down quietly and reach a side window.

Inside is a dark office space with only a few lights still on.

scenes.title: Security Room
scenes.narrative:
You drop into a room filled with monitors.

One guard sits watching the screens, unaware of you.

scenes.title: Server Room
scenes.narrative:
You reach a massive room filled with glowing servers.

This is where the data is stored. You can start downloading now, or explore further.

scenes.title: Lobby
scenes.narrative:
The doors slide open silently.

The lobby is empty, but cameras track every movement.

scenes.title: Office Floor
scenes.narrative:
Cubicles stretch across the room. Computers glow faintly.

You find employee credentials on a desk.

scenes.title: Basement Access
scenes.narrative:
You drop into the basement.

It’s darker here. You hear machinery... and something else.

scenes.title: Hallway
scenes.narrative:
You move through a long hallway.

Footsteps echo nearby. Security is getting closer.

scenes.title: Control Access
scenes.narrative:
You gain access to the building systems.

You can now control cameras, locks, and alarms.

scenes.title: Downloading...
scenes.narrative:
The data begins transferring.

Suddenly, a warning flashes: TRACE DETECTED.

scenes.title: Hidden Lab
scenes.narrative:
You discover a secret lab.

Inside are experiments... not human. Helix Corp is hiding something alive.

scenes.title: Experiment Room
scenes.narrative:
A creature sits inside a containment pod.

It opens its eyes and looks directly at you.

scenes.title: Elevator
scenes.narrative:
You enter the elevator.

Top floor or basement?

scenes.title: Escape Route
scenes.narrative:
You find an exit route.

Sirens begin to echo through the building.

scenes.title: Alarm Triggered
scenes.narrative:
Red lights flash. Alarms scream.

Security is closing in fast.

scenes.title: Perfect Heist
scenes.narrative:
You disable security completely.

You walk out with full access and no one ever knows you were there.

A perfect job.

scenes.title: Escape
scenes.narrative:
You escape into the neon night.

You didn’t get everything, but you made it out alive.

scenes.title: Trace Complete
scenes.narrative:
The download finishes...

But so does the trace.

Security bursts in.

You’re caught.

scenes.title: Chaos Unleashed
scenes.narrative:
The creature escapes.

It tears through the building, causing destruction everywhere.

In the chaos, you slip away—but the city will never be the same.

scenes.title: Overwhelmed
scenes.narrative:
You try to fight, but security is too strong.

The mission ends here.
